capabilities: Pull database rows in as Markdown notes
Push frontmatter edits back to the remote record
Resolve field conflicts with manual, Obsidian-wins or remote-wins modes
Refetch computed fields after a push
Build notes from {{field}} templates and sort them into subfolders
disambiguation: Not only a one-way importer: it also pushes local frontmatter edits back to the database.
extras: No telemetry; Supabase publishable keys need a one-time SECURITY DEFINER SQL function before saving; Notion page bodies are pull-only and local body edits are overwritten on the next pull.
problem: Database records and vault notes have to be copied by hand, so edits made on either side go stale.
